Question: What is the average policy size which is the the total amount of premium divided by the number of policies?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS decimal(18,2)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier), 0) AS average_policy_size
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(prm.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50)), ', ') AS policy_holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    prm.premium_amount_paid
ORDER BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number;

    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder,
    ag.Party_Identifier AS agent,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pr.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium prm
        ON prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role ph
    ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND ph.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICY_HOLDER'
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role ag
    ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND ag.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Party_Identifier,
    ag.Party_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    pr.premium_amount_paid;
